registered_before_run: Committed and pushed before scripts/research/velo_cfd_stage0.py first runs and before any Dukascopy history for the window is fetched by this lane.
question: Do the four legs that carry the RULE-PROP-FRONTIER-EV6M-20261112 pass keep a net edge on the CFD underlying's own price series (spot silver, WTI, spot gold) at Velotrade's cost stack, and does the 6-month EV pass survive on those ledgers with each leg dropped in turn?

population.why_these: The commodity legs of VELO_ALL. Their pooled net R is the only part of that book with a CI clear of zero ([+0.096, +0.681], n=218); the equity-ETF legs were net negative at Velotrade costs.
population.data: Dukascopy 1h BID bars via scripts/ops/fetch_dukascopy_ohlcv.py (dukascopy-python==4.0.1), filtered to the US cash session with --rth-only so the bar grid matches the ETF feed each leg was measured on; 1d legs resample those RTH bars. Window 2019-01-01..2026-10-31 (UTC). Leg parameters are taken unchanged from config/strategies.yaml (fingerprints above): nothing is fitted to this series.
population.harness: scripts/research/regime_debt_matrix.build_harness_cmd (the same argv the Stage-0 evidence producer builds), --fee-bps-roundtrip 0; the run's gross_r per trade is re-costed below.

slv_trend_1h.overnight_fee: 0.05% of notional per 00:30 UTC rollover held, weekends included (prop_ev_sim swap_model dxtrade, swap_daily 0.0005)

uso_trend_1h.overnight_fee: 0.05% of notional per 00:30 UTC rollover held, weekends included (prop_ev_sim swap_model dxtrade, swap_daily 0.0005)

gld_pullback_1h.overnight_fee: 0.05% of notional per 00:30 UTC rollover held, weekends included (prop_ev_sim swap_model dxtrade, swap_daily 0.0005)

gld_pullback_1d.overnight_fee: 0.05% of notional per 00:30 UTC rollover held, weekends included (prop_ev_sim swap_model dxtrade, swap_daily 0.0005)

costs.sources: Velotrade 1P velotrade.com/blog/velotrade-review fetched 2026-11-12: commission 0.01% per side on commodities, no spread markup, overnight fee 0.05% of notional at 00:30 UTC incl. weekends. The spread line is an ASSUMPTION (the bars are bid-only and Velotrade's raw quoted spread was not read): 3 bps RT gold, 5 bps RT silver and WTI. Slippage 3 bps RT as in RQ-20261112-09d2-06.

per_leg_predicate: PASS iff ALL: n >= 30 trades in the window; pooled net R > 0; at least 60% of calendar years with >= 1 trade have net R > 0; the per-trade net-R mean's lower bound at z = 2.241 (one-sided 0.05 Bonferroni over 4 legs) > 0. Otherwise FAIL (or INDETERMINATE if the harness/fetch failed: we could not look).
book_predicate: On the PASS legs only (if >= 1): re-run RULE-PROP-FRONTIER-EV6M-20261112's engine and predicate (prop_ev_sim path mode, 182 d, 3 seeds x 1000 lives, risk 0.5% of start, dd switch 0.8, lev cap 5, Velotrade CLASSIC 1-Step and PRO 1-Step) on these spot ledgers clipped to window_start 2019-01-01, costs as above (spread folded into slippage). BUYABLE iff the full surviving book passes the EV6M predicate AND, DROP-ONE SENSITIVITY (named up front), for every leg L in a book of >= 2 legs, the book without L still has worst-seed EV > 0 and mean EV > its zero-edge null. A book of 1 leg passes on the EV6M predicate alone and is reported as single-leg.
on_pass: Buy-point condition 1 of docs/research/prop-frontier-2026-11-12.md section 6 is met for the PASS legs; conditions 2 (VELO-INSTR-READ) and 4 (per-leg prop_survival SUPERSET) remain.
on_fail: No Velotrade CFD purchase on this book. The memo records which legs failed and why (cost vs gross edge).
known_limits: slv_trend_1h declares tp_r: 50.0, which the TP doctrine counts as non-compliant (check_tp_doctrine.py); a prop routing would need a real TP. Measured as configured.
Spot gold/silver/WTI are proxies for Velotrade's CFD prices; WTI spot vs a rolled CFD differs on roll.
RTH-only bars ignore overnight price action for signals, exactly as the ETF legs do; positions still hold overnight and pay the overnight fee.
